description: Source code for managing bots within the Mattermost server, including creation, patching, retrieval, activation, deactivation, deletion, ownership transfer, and user conversion functionalities.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing bot management functionalities within the Mattermost server.

methods.name: EnsureBot
methods.description: Ensures a bot exists with the specified parameters, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: CreateBot
methods.description: Creates a new bot and associated user, handling validation, storage, and notification.

methods.name: GetSystemBot
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the system-owned bot.

methods.name: GetOrCreateSystemOwnedBot
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a system-owned bot with specified username and display name.

methods.name: getOrCreateBot
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a bot based on its username.

methods.name: PatchBot
methods.description: Applies a patch to a bot and its associated user.

methods.name: GetBot
methods.description: Retrieves a bot by user ID.

methods.name: GetBots
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bots based on options.

methods.name: IsBotExemptFromDMRestrictions
methods.description: Checks if a bot is exempt from direct message restrictions.

methods.name: UpdateBotActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a bot and its user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteBot
methods.description: Permanently deletes a bot and its user.

methods.name: UpdateBotOwner
methods.description: Changes the owner of a bot.

methods.name: disableUserBots
methods.description: Disables all bots owned by a specific user.

methods.name: notifySysadminsBotOwnerDeactivated
methods.description: Notifies system admins when a bot owner is deactivated.

methods.name: getDisableBotSysadminMessage
methods.description: Generates a message informing sysadmins about bots owned by a deactivated user.

methods.name: ConvertUserToBot
methods.description: Converts a user account into a bot account.
